title: Defer downstream Gateway readiness until governed convergence verification

phases.objective: Allow immutable server-governed Activation Gateway convergence planning when governed Gateway drift coexists with a downstream manual-or-external readiness failure that must be re-evaluated after apply, without weakening fail-closed dependency, integrity, or mutation-authority boundaries.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A live-equivalent Staging failure set containing governed Gateway drift plus gateway_upstream_ready=false reaches immutable approval-required plan construction, while unavailable Gateway health remains blocked and no provider or Production mutation authority is introduced.
steps: Classify live-equivalent gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress and gateway_exact_commit failures as governed convergence drift.
Classify gateway_upstream_ready=false as manual_or_external readiness rather than provider-mutation plan content.
Permit plan construction only because governed drift exists and defer that downstream readiness condition to post-apply verification.
Keep gateway_health_reachable=false blocking so dependency availability cannot be bypassed.
Keep automatic_apply_allowed false; operator acknowledgement and server-governed execution authority remain separate requirements.
assertions: The live-equivalent degraded failure set is classified reconciliation_required rather than blocked.
The convergence engine emits approval_required with an immutable plan SHA-256.
The immutable provider-mutation plan contains only governed drift and does not treat gateway_upstream_ready as an apply mutation.
No Production deploy, provider mutation, Cloudflare mutation, database mutation, migration apply, Breakglass, or authority widening is performed by this change.
